supporting_observations.claim: At 14:16:09 UTC, Explorer set a UserAssist registry value whose ROT13-encoded subkey and path decode to a Windows PowerShell executable path.
The PowerShell-related registry event is more than 36 minutes after the reported appearance around 13:40 UTC, so it does not establish that PowerShell appeared at the alerted time.
Near the reported time, proxy records show ivy.chen's browser accessing Salesforce login pages and related resources; those records do not identify a PowerShell process or its command line.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor coverage metadata reports that winsec and Sysmon were not collected on WS-ICHEN-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC due to a collection outage. This includes the reported time around 13:40.
Proxy and Zeek connection telemetry were available, but the supplied records do not provide process creation or command-line evidence for the reported time.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually appeared around 13:40 UTC, and, if so, which process launched it.
The PowerShell command line, script contents, parent process, user context, and purpose.
Whether the PowerShell-related UserAssist entry at 14:16 UTC is connected to the reported appearance.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain alternate endpoint telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, especially process creation, PowerShell operational logs, and command-line or script-block logging.
Interview ivy.chen about the observed window and any actions taken near 13:40 UTC.
Check endpoint artifacts for PowerShell history, console host records, scheduled tasks, and relevant file or script activity during the alert window.
unrelated_findings: At 13:26 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 established a proxy tunnel to desktop.dropbox.com using a DropboxUpdate user agent. Dropbox is not listed as approved; assess separately. (T054-00062)

GlobalProtect PanGPA.exe ran on WS-ICHEN-01 under ivy.chen at 13:29 UTC, and Cisco AnyConnect vpnagent.exe started at 14:18 UTC. The inventory says there is no VPN; assess these client launches separately without treating them as evidence of a VPN connection. (T054-00069, T054-00070, T054-00372, T054-00373)
